messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — need to lock launch gating for the observability console features in next sprint. Proposing an MVP surface: dashboard templates (cost + latency + error heatmap), a lightweight trace sampling hook UI, and an error-aggregation widget. Agree?
Sam (SRE): +1 on templates. main concern: query cost on dashboards if we keep high-cardinality spans. We should cap default retention or add sampling before GA. :thinking_face:
Leon (Eng): Agree with sampling. For tracing hooks I want to avoid full-span capture by default — expensive. Suggest default sampling + route-based overrides. Implementation effort estimated 3 dev-weeks for runtime + 1 week for UI.
Olivia (Design): I can rapid-prototype compact widgets for the error heatmap and a small 'quick insights' panel that surfaces top 3 error spikes and likely cause. Need acceptance criteria for UX: <=2 clicks to get to trace, and charts must be readable on 1200px width.
Ben (Data): For cost breakdown: we need a schema. Minimum: {route, model, tokens_generated, tokens_cached, timestamp}. Also want an aggregated view for last 7d and per-customer rollups. If we can't do full per-route now, do a sampled per-route rollup.
Maya (PM): Good notes. Drafting launch criteria proposal: 1) Dashboard templates render under 1s 95p on staging with 7d data; 2) Trace hook UI allows set sampling by route and persists to config; 3) Error widget surfaces top-3 anomalies with links to traces. Anything missing?
Sam (SRE): Add reliability gate: fallback when trace backend is degraded — UI shows 'partial traces' and we don't block dashboard queries. Also SLO for trace ingest latency < 2s for sampled flows.
Leon (Eng): Implementation detail suggestion: enforce sampling server-side with config like:
```yaml
trace_sampling:
  default: 0.05
  routes:
    /api/v1/generate: 0.15
    /embed: 0.02
```
That keeps runtime cost bounded.
Olivia (Design): UX acceptance: if a customer increases sampling on a route, show an inline cost estimate + a confirmation modal. Otherwise folks toggle blindly.
Maya (PM): Customer asks: AcmeHealth wants 100% trace capture for a small set of HIPAA routes behind Private deployments. We can support via dedicated capacity (Dedicated/Private) as an enterprise opt-in — mark as non-MVP.
Ben (Data): One more ask: include a flag for "cached tokens" in cost view so we can show savings from KV caching. Helps marketing stories.
Maya (PM): Proposal to prioritize for the sprint: 1) Dashboard templates + cost schema (highest), 2) Trace sampling API + UI (medium), 3) Error aggregation widget (lower if timeline tight). Canary plan: roll dashboards to 5% orgs first, monitor query latency and token cost delta for 24h.
Sam (SRE): +1. Add alarm: if dashboard median query latency increases 30% or token spend delta > 20% vs baseline -> rollback.
Leon (Eng): Dev plan accepted. I'll scope runtime and create a spike PR for sampling enforcement. ETA for spike: 3 days.
Olivia (Design): I'll deliver low-fi mocks by EOD tomorrow, then iterate after eng spike.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: observability/feature-branch -> staging (build 642).
Maya (PM): Thanks team — I'll put these acceptance gates into the roadmap doc and schedule a 30-min checkpoint Thursday 10am. If anyone needs to move items between cuts, ping here. :thumbsup:
